import ZFCinPA.ValidatorEnvironmentLabels254
import ZFCinPA.ModelCodedSpecialization

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

/-!
Source opening in a configurable internal environment. The distinguished
bound slot can be any internal index d: lower slots retain their labels,
and the final slot is moved to the head of the free environment. All state
and syntax values are internal. This is a syntax identity, without a CProv
proof-renaming, freshness or alpha-conversion assertion.
-/
namespace LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ValidatorEnvironmentOpening254
open LO LO.FirstOrder LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
open LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic.Bootstrapping
open ValidatorEnvironmentLabels254 ModelCodedSpecialization
open scoped LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
variable {V : Type*} [ORingStructure V] [V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝚺₁]

/-- B' extends B at its final slot; all dimensions and indices are internal. -/
def Ext (d B B' x : V) : Prop :=
  len B=d ∧ len B'=d+1 ∧ (∀ i<d, B'.[i]=B.[i]) ∧ B'.[d]=x

lemma ext_zero (x : V) : Ext (0 : V) 0 (x∷0) x := by simp [Ext]
lemma ext_cons {d B B' x : V} (h : Ext d B B' x) (label : V) :
    Ext (d+1) (label∷B) (label∷B') x := by
  refine ⟨by simpa using congrArg (fun z : V => z+1) h.1,
    by simpa using congrArg (fun z : V => z+1) h.2.1,?_,?_⟩
  · intro i hi
    rcases zero_or_succ i with (rfl | ⟨i,rfl⟩)
    · simp
    · simpa using h.2.2.1 i (by simpa using hi)
  · simpa using h.2.2.2

noncomputable def openingVec (d : V) : V := qVecIter ℒₛₑₜ d (^&0∷0)
lemma openingVec_typed (d : V) : IsSemitermVec ℒₛₑₜ (d+1) d (openingVec d) := by
  simpa [openingVec,add_comm] using qVecIter_isSemitermVec (L := ℒₛₑₜ)
    (show IsSemitermVec (V := V) ℒₛₑₜ 1 0 (^&0∷0) by simp) d
@[simp] lemma openingVec_succ (d : V) : openingVec (d+1)=qVec ℒₛₑₜ (openingVec d) :=
  qVecIter_succ d _

noncomputable def termOpenAt (d source : V) : V :=
  termSubst ℒₛₑₜ (openingVec d) (termShift ℒₛₑₜ source)
noncomputable def openAt (d source : V) : V :=
  subst ℒₛₑₜ (openingVec d) (shift ℒₛₑₜ source)

lemma term_labels_open {d source : V} (ht : IsSemiterm ℒₛₑₜ (d+1) source)
    (F B B' x : V) (hB : Ext d B B' x) :
    TermLabels.term (x∷F) B (termOpenAt d source)=TermLabels.term F B' source := by
  rcases ht.case with (⟨i,hi,rfl⟩ | ⟨j,rfl⟩ | ⟨k,f,args,hf,_,rfl⟩)
  · unfold termOpenAt
    rw [termShift_bvar,termSubst_bvar]
    by_cases hid : i<d
    · rw [show (openingVec d).[i]=(^#i : V) from
        (qVecIter_free_spec (L := ℒₛₑₜ) d 0).1 i hid]
      rw [TermLabels.term_bvar,TermLabels.term_bvar,hB.2.2.1 i hid]
    · have he : i=d := le_antisymm (lt_succ_iff_le.mp hi) (le_of_not_gt hid)
      subst i
      rw [show (openingVec d).[d]=(^&0 : V) from
        (qVecIter_free_spec (L := ℒₛₑₜ) d 0).2]
      rw [TermLabels.term_fvar,freeLabel_cons_zero,TermLabels.term_bvar,hB.2.2.2]
  · simp [termOpenAt]
  · have hfalse : False := by
      simpa [Language.IsFunc,Language.isFunc,LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.instLORDefinableSet] using hf
    exact hfalse.elim

lemma vec_labels_open {d arity terms : V} (ht : IsSemitermVec ℒₛₑₜ arity (d+1) terms)
    (F B B' x : V) (hB : Ext d B B' x) :
    TermLabels.vec (x∷F) B arity
      (termSubstVec ℒₛₑₜ arity (openingVec d) (termShiftVec ℒₛₑₜ arity terms))=
      TermLabels.vec F B' arity terms := by
  have hn := (openingVec_typed d).termSubstVec ht.termShiftVec
  apply nth_ext' arity
  · exact TermLabels.vec_length (x∷F) B hn.isUTerm
  · exact TermLabels.vec_length F B' ht.isUTerm
  · intro i hi
    rw [TermLabels.vec_nth (x∷F) B hn.isUTerm hi,
      nth_termSubstVec ht.termShiftVec.isUTerm hi,nth_termShiftVec ht.isUTerm hi,
      TermLabels.vec_nth F B' ht.isUTerm hi]
    exact term_labels_open (ht.nth hi) F B B' x hB

lemma openAt_isSemiformula {d p : V} (hp : IsSemiformula ℒₛₑₜ (d+1) p) :
    IsSemiformula ℒₛₑₜ d (openAt d p) := hp.shift.subst (openingVec_typed d)

lemma openAt_rel (d : V) {arity R terms : V}
    (hr : (ℒₛₑₜ).IsRel arity R) (ht : IsUTermVec ℒₛₑₜ arity terms) :
    openAt d (^rel arity R terms)=
      ^rel arity R (termSubstVec ℒₛₑₜ arity (openingVec d) (termShiftVec ℒₛₑₜ arity terms)) := by
  rw [openAt,shift_rel hr ht,substs_rel hr ht.termShiftVec]
lemma openAt_nrel (d : V) {arity R terms : V}
    (hr : (ℒₛₑₜ).IsRel arity R) (ht : IsUTermVec ℒₛₑₜ arity terms) :
    openAt d (^nrel arity R terms)=
      ^nrel arity R (termSubstVec ℒₛₑₜ arity (openingVec d) (termShiftVec ℒₛₑₜ arity terms)) := by
  rw [openAt,shift_nrel hr ht,substs_nrel hr ht.termShiftVec]
@[simp] lemma openAt_verum (d : V) : openAt d (^⊤ : V)=^⊤ := by simp [openAt]
@[simp] lemma openAt_falsum (d : V) : openAt d (^⊥ : V)=^⊥ := by simp [openAt]
lemma openAt_and (d : V) {p q : V} (hp : IsUFormula ℒₛₑₜ p) (hq : IsUFormula ℒₛₑₜ q) :
    openAt d (p ^⋏ q)=openAt d p ^⋏ openAt d q := by
  rw [openAt,shift_and hp hq,substs_and hp.shift hq.shift];rfl
lemma openAt_or (d : V) {p q : V} (hp : IsUFormula ℒₛₑₜ p) (hq : IsUFormula ℒₛₑₜ q) :
    openAt d (p ^⋎ q)=openAt d p ^⋎ openAt d q := by
  rw [openAt,shift_or hp hq,substs_or hp.shift hq.shift];rfl
lemma openAt_all (d : V) {p : V} (hp : IsUFormula ℒₛₑₜ p) :
    openAt d (^∀ p)=^∀ (openAt (d+1) p) := by
  rw [openAt,shift_all hp,substs_all hp.shift,←openingVec_succ];rfl
lemma openAt_exs (d : V) {p : V} (hp : IsUFormula ℒₛₑₜ p) :
    openAt d (^∃ p)=^∃ (openAt (d+1) p) := by
  rw [openAt,shift_exs hp,substs_ex hp.shift,←openingVec_succ];rfl

lemma encode_openAt {d p : V} (hp : IsSemiformula ℒₛₑₜ (d+1) p)
    (F B B' x fresh : V) (hB : Ext d B B' x) :
    encode (x∷F) B fresh (openAt d p)=encode F B' fresh p := by
  have main : ∀ n p : V, IsSemiformula ℒₛₑₜ n p →
      ∀ d : V, n=d+1 → ∀ F B B' x fresh : V, Ext d B B' x →
        encode (x∷F) B fresh (openAt d p)=encode F B' fresh p := by
    intro n p hp
    apply IsSemiformula.pi1_structural_induction (P := fun n p =>
      ∀ d : V, n=d+1 → ∀ F B B' x fresh : V, Ext d B B' x →
        encode (x∷F) B fresh (openAt d p)=encode F B' fresh p)
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hp
    · unfold Ext openAt openingVec; definability
    · intro n arity R terms hr ht d hn F B B' x s hB
      subst n
      have hv := (openingVec_typed d).termSubstVec ht.termShiftVec
      rw [openAt_rel d hr ht.isUTerm,encode_rel (x∷F) B s hr hv.isUTerm,
        encode_rel F B' s hr ht.isUTerm]
      simp only [ValidatorEnvironmentLabels254.Formulas.atom,nth_adjoin_zero,nth_adjoin_one,
        vec_labels_open ht F B B' x hB]
    · intro n arity R terms hr ht d hn F B B' x s hB
      subst n
      have hv := (openingVec_typed d).termSubstVec ht.termShiftVec
      rw [openAt_nrel d hr ht.isUTerm,encode_nrel (x∷F) B s hr hv.isUTerm,
        encode_nrel F B' s hr ht.isUTerm]
      simp only [ValidatorEnvironmentLabels254.Formulas.atom,nth_adjoin_zero,nth_adjoin_one,
        vec_labels_open ht F B B' x hB]
    · intro n d hn F B B' x s hB; simp
    · intro n d hn F B B' x s hB; simp
    · intro n p q hp hq ihp ihq d hn F B B' x s hB
      subst n
      rw [openAt_and d hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula,
        encode_and (x∷F) B s (openAt_isSemiformula hp).isUFormula
          (openAt_isSemiformula hq).isUFormula,
        encode_and F B' s hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula,
        ihp d rfl F B B' x s hB,ihq d rfl F B B' x s hB]
    · intro n p q hp hq ihp ihq d hn F B B' x s hB
      subst n
      rw [openAt_or d hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula,
        encode_or (x∷F) B s (openAt_isSemiformula hp).isUFormula
          (openAt_isSemiformula hq).isUFormula,
        encode_or F B' s hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula,
        ihp d rfl F B B' x s hB,ihq d rfl F B B' x s hB]
    · intro n p hp ih d hn F B B' x s hB
      subst n
      rw [openAt_all d hp.isUFormula,
        encode_all (x∷F) B s (openAt_isSemiformula hp).isUFormula,
        encode_all F B' s hp.isUFormula]
      exact congrArg (fun body => _root_.SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticCode254.wal s body)
        (ih (d+1) rfl F (s∷B) (s∷B') x (s+2) (ext_cons hB s))
    · intro n p hp ih d hn F B B' x s hB
      subst n
      rw [openAt_exs d hp.isUFormula,
        encode_exs (x∷F) B s (openAt_isSemiformula hp).isUFormula,
        encode_exs F B' s hp.isUFormula,
        ih (d+1) rfl F (s∷B) (s∷B') x (s+2) (ext_cons hB s)]
  exact main (d+1) p hp d rfl F B B' x fresh hB

/-- The matrix identity used by the actual Foundation ALL rule. Source and
target contexts still require the separate formula-level alpha theorem. -/
lemma encode_free {p : V} (hp : IsSemiformula ℒₛₑₜ 1 p) (F x fresh : V) :
    encode (x∷F) 0 fresh (free ℒₛₑₜ p)=encode F (x∷0) fresh p := by
  simpa [openAt,openingVec,free,substs1] using
    encode_openAt (d := 0) hp F 0 (x∷0) x fresh (ext_zero x)

/-- The exact opened matrix occurring in the actual universal-introduction rule.
The starting binder is also the label placed at the free-environment head. -/
lemma encode_all_opened {p : V} (hp : IsSemiformula ℒₛₑₜ 1 p) (F x : V) :
    encode F 0 x (^∀ p)=
      _root_.SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticCode254.wal x
        (encode (x∷F) 0 (x+2) (free ℒₛₑₜ p)) := by
  rw [encode_all F 0 x hp.isUFormula,encode_free hp F x (x+2)]

lemma encode_exs_opened {p : V} (hp : IsSemiformula ℒₛₑₜ 1 p) (F x : V) :
    encode F 0 x (^∃ p)=
      _root_.SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticCode254.wim
        (_root_.SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticCode254.wal x
          (_root_.SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticCode254.wim
            (encode (x∷F) 0 (x+2) (free ℒₛₑₜ p)) 1)) 1 := by
  rw [encode_exs F 0 x hp.isUFormula,encode_free hp F x (x+2)]

import ZFCinPA.ValidatorEnvironmentLabels254
import ZFCinPA.ModelCodedSpecialization

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

/-!
Source opening in a configurable internal environment. The distinguished
bound slot can be any internal index d: lower slots retain their labels,
and the final slot is moved to the head of the free environment. All state
and syntax values are internal. This is a syntax identity, without a CProv
proof-renaming, freshness or alpha-conversion assertion.
-/
namespace LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ValidatorEnvironmentOpening254
open LO LO.FirstOrder LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
open LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic.Bootstrapping
open ValidatorEnvironmentLabels254 ModelCodedSpecialization
open scoped LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
variable {V : Type*} [ORingStructure V] [V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝚺₁]

/-- B' extends B at its final slot; all dimensions and indices are internal. -/
def Ext (d B B' x : V) : Prop :=
  len B=d ∧ len B'=d+1 ∧ (∀ i<d, B'.[i]=B.[i]) ∧ B'.[d]=x

lemma ext_zero (x : V) : Ext (0 : V) 0 (x∷0) x := by simp [Ext]
lemma ext_cons {d B B' x : V} (h : Ext d B B' x) (label : V) :
    Ext (d+1) (label∷B) (label∷B') x := by
  refine ⟨by simpa using congrArg (fun z : V => z+1) h.1,
    by simpa using congrArg (fun z : V => z+1) h.2.1,?_,?_⟩
  · intro i hi
    rcases zero_or_succ i with (rfl | ⟨i,rfl⟩)
    · simp
    · simpa using h.2.2.1 i (by simpa using hi)
  · simpa using h.2.2.2

noncomputable def openingVec (d : V) : V := qVecIter ℒₛₑₜ d (^&0∷0)
lemma openingVec_typed (d : V) : IsSemitermVec ℒₛₑₜ (d+1) d (openingVec d) := by
  simpa [openingVec,add_comm] using qVecIter_isSemitermVec (L := ℒₛₑₜ)
    (show IsSemitermVec (V := V) ℒₛₑₜ 1 0 (^&0∷0) by simp) d
@[simp] lemma openingVec_succ (d : V) : openingVec (d+1)=qVec ℒₛₑₜ (openingVec d) :=
  qVecIter_succ d _

noncomputable def termOpenAt (d source : V) : V :=
  termSubst ℒₛₑₜ (openingVec d) (termShift ℒₛₑₜ source)
noncomputable def openAt (d source : V) : V :=
  subst ℒₛₑₜ (openingVec d) (shift ℒₛₑₜ source)

lemma term_labels_open {d source : V} (ht : IsSemiterm ℒₛₑₜ (d+1) source)
    (F B B' x : V) (hB : Ext d B B' x) :
    TermLabels.term (x∷F) B (termOpenAt d source)=TermLabels.term F B' source := by
  rcases ht.case with (⟨i,hi,rfl⟩ | ⟨j,rfl⟩ | ⟨k,f,args,hf,_,rfl⟩)
  · unfold termOpenAt
    rw [termShift_bvar,termSubst_bvar]
    by_cases hid : i<d
    · rw [show (openingVec d).[i]=(^#i : V) from
        (qVecIter_free_spec (L := ℒₛₑₜ) d 0).1 i hid]
      rw [TermLabels.term_bvar,TermLabels.term_bvar,hB.2.2.1 i hid]
    · have he : i=d := le_antisymm (lt_succ_iff_le.mp hi) (le_of_not_gt hid)
      subst i
      rw [show (openingVec d).[d]=(^&0 : V) from
        (qVecIter_free_spec (L := ℒₛₑₜ) d 0).2]
      rw [TermLabels.term_fvar,freeLabel_cons_zero,TermLabels.term_bvar,hB.2.2.2]
  · simp [termOpenAt]
  · have hfalse : False := by
      have hf' : V ⊧/![k,f] (LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.instLORDefinableSet.func).val := hf
      rw [show (LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.instLORDefinableSet.func : 𝚺₀.Semisentence 2) =
        .mkSigma “k f. ⊥” from rfl] at hf'
      simp at hf'
    exact hfalse.elim

lemma vec_labels_open {d arity terms : V} (ht : IsSemitermVec ℒₛₑₜ arity (d+1) terms)
    (F B B' x : V) (hB : Ext d B B' x) :
    TermLabels.vec (x∷F) B arity
      (termSubstVec ℒₛₑₜ arity (openingVec d) (termShiftVec ℒₛₑₜ arity terms))=
      TermLabels.vec F B' arity terms := by
  have hn := (openingVec_typed d).termSubstVec ht.termShiftVec
  apply nth_ext' arity
  · exact TermLabels.vec_length (x∷F) B hn.isUTerm
  · exact TermLabels.vec_length F B' ht.isUTerm
  · intro i hi
    rw [TermLabels.vec_nth (x∷F) B hn.isUTerm hi,
      nth_termSubstVec ht.termShiftVec.isUTerm hi,nth_termShiftVec ht.isUTerm hi,
      TermLabels.vec_nth F B' ht.isUTerm hi]
    exact term_labels_open (ht.nth hi) F B B' x hB

lemma openAt_isSemiformula {d p : V} (hp : IsSemiformula ℒₛₑₜ (d+1) p) :
    IsSemiformula ℒₛₑₜ d (openAt d p) := hp.shift.subst (openingVec_typed d)

lemma openAt_rel (d : V) {arity R terms : V}
    (hr : (ℒₛₑₜ).IsRel arity R) (ht : IsUTermVec ℒₛₑₜ arity terms) :
    openAt d (^rel arity R terms)=
      ^rel arity R (termSubstVec ℒₛₑₜ arity (openingVec d) (termShiftVec ℒₛₑₜ arity terms)) := by
  rw [openAt,shift_rel hr ht,substs_rel hr ht.termShiftVec]
lemma openAt_nrel (d : V) {arity R terms : V}
    (hr : (ℒₛₑₜ).IsRel arity R) (ht : IsUTermVec ℒₛₑₜ arity terms) :
    openAt d (^nrel arity R terms)=
      ^nrel arity R (termSubstVec ℒₛₑₜ arity (openingVec d) (termShiftVec ℒₛₑₜ arity terms)) := by
  rw [openAt,shift_nrel hr ht,substs_nrel hr ht.termShiftVec]
@[simp] lemma openAt_verum (d : V) : openAt d (^⊤ : V)=^⊤ := by simp [openAt]
@[simp] lemma openAt_falsum (d : V) : openAt d (^⊥ : V)=^⊥ := by simp [openAt]
lemma openAt_and (d : V) {p q : V} (hp : IsUFormula ℒₛₑₜ p) (hq : IsUFormula ℒₛₑₜ q) :
    openAt d (p ^⋏ q)=openAt d p ^⋏ openAt d q := by
  rw [openAt,shift_and hp hq,substs_and hp.shift hq.shift];rfl
lemma openAt_or (d : V) {p q : V} (hp : IsUFormula ℒₛₑₜ p) (hq : IsUFormula ℒₛₑₜ q) :
    openAt d (p ^⋎ q)=openAt d p ^⋎ openAt d q := by
  rw [openAt,shift_or hp hq,substs_or hp.shift hq.shift];rfl
lemma openAt_all (d : V) {p : V} (hp : IsUFormula ℒₛₑₜ p) :
    openAt d (^∀ p)=^∀ (openAt (d+1) p) := by
  rw [openAt,shift_all hp,substs_all hp.shift,←openingVec_succ];rfl
lemma openAt_exs (d : V) {p : V} (hp : IsUFormula ℒₛₑₜ p) :
    openAt d (^∃ p)=^∃ (openAt (d+1) p) := by
  rw [openAt,shift_exs hp,substs_ex hp.shift,←openingVec_succ];rfl

private instance qVecIter_delta : 𝚫₁-Function₂[V] (qVecIter ℒₛₑₜ) :=
  qVecIter_defined.graph_delta.to_definable
private instance subst_delta : 𝚫₁-Function₂[V] (subst ℒₛₑₜ) :=
  subst.defined.graph_delta.to_definable
private instance shift_delta : 𝚫₁-Function₁[V] (shift ℒₛₑₜ) :=
  shift.defined.graph_delta.to_definable
private instance len_delta : 𝚫₁-Function₁[V] (len : V→V) :=
  len_defined.graph_delta.to_definable

lemma encode_openAt {d p : V} (hp : IsSemiformula ℒₛₑₜ (d+1) p)
    (F B B' x fresh : V) (hB : Ext d B B' x) :
    encode (x∷F) B fresh (openAt d p)=encode F B' fresh p := by
  have main : ∀ n p : V, IsSemiformula ℒₛₑₜ n p →
      ∀ d : V, n=d+1 → ∀ F B B' x fresh : V, Ext d B B' x →
        encode (x∷F) B fresh (openAt d p)=encode F B' fresh p := by
    intro n p hp
    apply IsSemiformula.pi1_structural_induction (P := fun n p =>
      ∀ d : V, n=d+1 → ∀ F B B' x fresh : V, Ext d B B' x →
        encode (x∷F) B fresh (openAt d p)=encode F B' fresh p)
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hp
    · unfold Ext openAt openingVec; definability
    · intro n arity R terms hr ht d hn F B B' x s hB
      subst n
      have hv := (openingVec_typed d).termSubstVec ht.termShiftVec
      rw [openAt_rel d hr ht.isUTerm,encode_rel (x∷F) B s hr hv.isUTerm,
        encode_rel F B' s hr ht.isUTerm]
      simp only [ValidatorEnvironmentLabels254.Formulas.atom,nth_adjoin_zero,nth_adjoin_one,
        vec_labels_open ht F B B' x hB]
    · intro n arity R terms hr ht d hn F B B' x s hB
      subst n
      have hv := (openingVec_typed d).termSubstVec ht.termShiftVec
      rw [openAt_nrel d hr ht.isUTerm,encode_nrel (x∷F) B s hr hv.isUTerm,
        encode_nrel F B' s hr ht.isUTerm]
      simp only [ValidatorEnvironmentLabels254.Formulas.atom,nth_adjoin_zero,nth_adjoin_one,
        vec_labels_open ht F B B' x hB]
    · intro n d hn F B B' x s hB; simp
    · intro n d hn F B B' x s hB; simp
    · intro n p q hp hq ihp ihq d hn F B B' x s hB
      subst n
      rw [openAt_and d hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula,
        encode_and (x∷F) B s (openAt_isSemiformula hp).isUFormula
          (openAt_isSemiformula hq).isUFormula,
        encode_and F B' s hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula,
        ihp d rfl F B B' x s hB,ihq d rfl F B B' x s hB]
    · intro n p q hp hq ihp ihq d hn F B B' x s hB
      subst n
      rw [openAt_or d hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula,
        encode_or (x∷F) B s (openAt_isSemiformula hp).isUFormula
          (openAt_isSemiformula hq).isUFormula,
        encode_or F B' s hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula,
        ihp d rfl F B B' x s hB,ihq d rfl F B B' x s hB]
    · intro n p hp ih d hn F B B' x s hB
      subst n
      rw [openAt_all d hp.isUFormula,
        encode_all (x∷F) B s (openAt_isSemiformula hp).isUFormula,
        encode_all F B' s hp.isUFormula]
      exact congrArg (fun body => _root_.SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticCode254.wal s body)
        (ih (d+1) rfl F (s∷B) (s∷B') x (s+2) (ext_cons hB s))
    · intro n p hp ih d hn F B B' x s hB
      subst n
      rw [openAt_exs d hp.isUFormula,
        encode_exs (x∷F) B s (openAt_isSemiformula hp).isUFormula,
        encode_exs F B' s hp.isUFormula,
        ih (d+1) rfl F (s∷B) (s∷B') x (s+2) (ext_cons hB s)]
  exact main (d+1) p hp d rfl F B B' x fresh hB

/-- The matrix identity used by the actual Foundation ALL rule. Source and
target contexts still require the separate formula-level alpha theorem. -/
lemma encode_free {p : V} (hp : IsSemiformula ℒₛₑₜ 1 p) (F x fresh : V) :
    encode (x∷F) 0 fresh (free ℒₛₑₜ p)=encode F (x∷0) fresh p := by
  simpa [openAt,openingVec,free,substs1] using
    encode_openAt (d := 0) (by simpa using hp) F 0 (x∷0) x fresh (ext_zero x)

/-- The exact opened matrix occurring in the actual universal-introduction rule.
The starting binder is also the label placed at the free-environment head. -/
lemma encode_all_opened {p : V} (hp : IsSemiformula ℒₛₑₜ 1 p) (F x : V) :
    encode F 0 x (^∀ p)=
      _root_.SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticCode254.wal x
        (encode (x∷F) 0 (x+2) (free ℒₛₑₜ p)) := by
  rw [encode_all F 0 x hp.isUFormula,encode_free hp F x (x+2)]

lemma encode_exs_opened {p : V} (hp : IsSemiformula ℒₛₑₜ 1 p) (F x : V) :
    encode F 0 x (^∃ p)=
      _root_.SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticCode254.wim
        (_root_.SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticCode254.wal x
          (_root_.SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticCode254.wim
            (encode (x∷F) 0 (x+2) (free ℒₛₑₜ p)) 1)) 1 := by
  rw [encode_exs F 0 x hp.isUFormula,encode_free hp F x (x+2)]

end LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ValidatorEnvironmentOpening254

variable {V : Type*} [ORingStructure V] [V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝚺₁]

example (x : V) : Ext (0 : V) 0 (x∷0) x := ext_zero x
example (d B B' x label : V) (h : Ext d B B' x) :
    Ext (d+1) (label∷B) (label∷B') x := ext_cons h label
example (d : V) : IsSemitermVec ℒₛₑₜ (d+1) d (openingVec d) := openingVec_typed d
example (d : V) : openingVec (d+1)=qVec ℒₛₑₜ (openingVec d) := openingVec_succ d
example (d t F B B' x : V) (ht : IsSemiterm ℒₛₑₜ (d+1) t) (h : Ext d B B' x) :
    TermLabels.term (x∷F) B (termOpenAt d t)=TermLabels.term F B' t :=
  term_labels_open ht F B B' x h
example (d k ts F B B' x : V) (ht : IsSemitermVec ℒₛₑₜ k (d+1) ts)
    (h : Ext d B B' x) :
    TermLabels.vec (x∷F) B k
      (termSubstVec ℒₛₑₜ k (openingVec d) (termShiftVec ℒₛₑₜ k ts))=
      TermLabels.vec F B' k ts := vec_labels_open ht F B B' x h
example (d p : V) (hp : IsSemiformula ℒₛₑₜ (d+1) p) :
    IsSemiformula ℒₛₑₜ d (openAt d p) := openAt_isSemiformula hp
example (d k R ts : V) (hr : (ℒₛₑₜ).IsRel k R) (ht : IsUTermVec ℒₛₑₜ k ts) :
    openAt d (^rel k R ts)=
      ^rel k R (termSubstVec ℒₛₑₜ k (openingVec d) (termShiftVec ℒₛₑₜ k ts)) :=
  openAt_rel d hr ht
example (d k R ts : V) (hr : (ℒₛₑₜ).IsRel k R) (ht : IsUTermVec ℒₛₑₜ k ts) :
    openAt d (^nrel k R ts)=
      ^nrel k R (termSubstVec ℒₛₑₜ k (openingVec d) (termShiftVec ℒₛₑₜ k ts)) :=
  openAt_nrel d hr ht
example (d : V) : openAt d (^⊤ : V)=^⊤ := openAt_verum d
example (d : V) : openAt d (^⊥ : V)=^⊥ := openAt_falsum d
example (d p q : V) (hp : IsUFormula ℒₛₑₜ p) (hq : IsUFormula ℒₛₑₜ q) :
    openAt d (p ^⋏ q)=openAt d p ^⋏ openAt d q := openAt_and d hp hq
example (d p q : V) (hp : IsUFormula ℒₛₑₜ p) (hq : IsUFormula ℒₛₑₜ q) :
    openAt d (p ^⋎ q)=openAt d p ^⋎ openAt d q := openAt_or d hp hq
example (d p : V) (hp : IsUFormula ℒₛₑₜ p) :
    openAt d (^∀ p)=^∀ (openAt (d+1) p) := openAt_all d hp
example (d p : V) (hp : IsUFormula ℒₛₑₜ p) :
    openAt d (^∃ p)=^∃ (openAt (d+1) p) := openAt_exs d hp
example (d p F B B' x s : V) (hp : IsSemiformula ℒₛₑₜ (d+1) p)
    (h : Ext d B B' x) :
    encode (x∷F) B s (openAt d p)=encode F B' s p := encode_openAt hp F B B' x s h
example (p F x s : V) (hp : IsSemiformula ℒₛₑₜ 1 p) :
    encode (x∷F) 0 s (free ℒₛₑₜ p)=encode F (x∷0) s p := encode_free hp F x s
example (p F x : V) (hp : IsSemiformula ℒₛₑₜ 1 p) :
    encode F 0 x (^∀ p)=wal x (encode (x∷F) 0 (x+2) (free ℒₛₑₜ p)) :=
  encode_all_opened hp F x
example (p F x : V) (hp : IsSemiformula ℒₛₑₜ 1 p) :
    encode F 0 x (^∃ p)=wim (wal x (wim (encode (x∷F) 0 (x+2) (free ℒₛₑₜ p)) 1)) 1 :=
  encode_exs_opened hp F x
example (p : V) (hp : IsSemiformula ℒₛₑₜ 1 p) :
    encode ((0 : V)∷0) 0 0 (free ℒₛₑₜ p)=encode 0 ((0 : V)∷0) 0 p :=
  encode_free hp 0 0 0
example (p F x s : V) (hp : IsSemiformula ℒₛₑₜ (1+1) p) :
    encode (x∷F) 0 s (free ℒₛₑₜ (^∀ p))=encode F (x∷0) s (^∀ p) :=
  encode_free (by simpa using hp) F x s
example (F x : V) : TermLabels.term (x∷F) 0 (termOpenAt 0 (^#0 : V))=x := by
  simpa using term_labels_open (d := 0) (source := (^#0 : V)) (by simp)
    F 0 (x∷0) x (ext_zero x)

import ZFCinPA.ValidatorEnvironmentLabels254
import ZFCinPA.ModelCodedSpecialization

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

/-!
Source opening in a configurable internal environment. The distinguished
bound slot can be any internal index d: lower slots retain their labels,
and the final slot is moved to the head of the free environment. All state
and syntax values are internal. This is a syntax identity, without a CProv
proof-renaming, freshness or alpha-conversion assertion.
-/
namespace LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ValidatorEnvironmentOpening254
open LO LO.FirstOrder LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
open LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic.Bootstrapping
open ValidatorEnvironmentLabels254 ModelCodedSpecialization
open scoped LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
variable {V : Type*} [ORingStructure V] [V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝚺₁]

/-- B' extends B at its final slot; all dimensions and indices are internal. -/
def Ext (d B B' x : V) : Prop :=
  len B=d ∧ len B'=d+1 ∧ (∀ i<d, B'.[i]=B.[i]) ∧ B'.[d]=x

lemma ext_zero (x : V) : Ext (0 : V) 0 (x∷0) x := by simp [Ext]
lemma ext_cons {d B B' x : V} (h : Ext d B B' x) (label : V) :
    Ext (d+1) (label∷B) (label∷B') x := by
  refine ⟨by simpa using congrArg (fun z : V => z+1) h.1,
    by simpa using congrArg (fun z : V => z+1) h.2.1,?_,?_⟩
  · intro i hi
    rcases zero_or_succ i with (rfl | ⟨i,rfl⟩)
    · simp
    · simpa using h.2.2.1 i (by simpa using hi)
  · simpa using h.2.2.2

noncomputable def openingVec (d : V) : V := qVecIter ℒₛₑₜ d (^&0∷0)
lemma openingVec_typed (d : V) : IsSemitermVec ℒₛₑₜ (d+1) d (openingVec d) := by
  simpa [openingVec,add_comm] using qVecIter_isSemitermVec (L := ℒₛₑₜ)
    (show IsSemitermVec (V := V) ℒₛₑₜ 1 0 (^&0∷0) by simp) d
@[simp] lemma openingVec_succ (d : V) : openingVec (d+1)=qVec ℒₛₑₜ (openingVec d) :=
  qVecIter_succ d _

noncomputable def termOpenAt (d source : V) : V :=
  termSubst ℒₛₑₜ (openingVec d) (termShift ℒₛₑₜ source)
noncomputable def openAt (d source : V) : V :=
  subst ℒₛₑₜ (openingVec d) (shift ℒₛₑₜ source)

lemma term_labels_open {d source : V} (ht : IsSemiterm ℒₛₑₜ (d+1) source)
    (F B B' x : V) (hB : Ext d B B' x) :
    TermLabels.term (x∷F) B (termOpenAt d source)=TermLabels.term F B' source := by
  rcases ht.case with (⟨i,hi,rfl⟩ | ⟨j,rfl⟩ | ⟨k,f,args,hf,_,rfl⟩)
  · unfold termOpenAt
    rw [termShift_bvar,termSubst_bvar]
    by_cases hid : i<d
    · rw [show (openingVec d).[i]=(^#i : V) from
        (qVecIter_free_spec (L := ℒₛₑₜ) d 0).1 i hid]
      rw [TermLabels.term_bvar,TermLabels.term_bvar,hB.2.2.1 i hid]
    · have he : i=d := le_antisymm (le_iff_lt_succ.mpr hi) (le_of_not_gt hid)
      subst i
      rw [show (openingVec d).[d]=(^&0 : V) from
        (qVecIter_free_spec (L := ℒₛₑₜ) d 0).2]
      rw [TermLabels.term_fvar,freeLabel_cons_zero,TermLabels.term_bvar,hB.2.2.2]
  · simp [termOpenAt]
  · have hfalse : False := by
      simpa [Language.IsFunc,Language.isFunc,LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.instLORDefinableSet] using hf
    exact hfalse.elim

lemma vec_labels_open {d arity terms : V} (ht : IsSemitermVec ℒₛₑₜ arity (d+1) terms)
    (F B B' x : V) (hB : Ext d B B' x) :
    TermLabels.vec (x∷F) B arity
      (termSubstVec ℒₛₑₜ arity (openingVec d) (termShiftVec ℒₛₑₜ arity terms))=
      TermLabels.vec F B' arity terms := by
  have hn := (openingVec_typed d).termSubstVec ht.termShiftVec
  apply nth_ext' arity
  · exact TermLabels.vec_length (x∷F) B hn.isUTerm
  · exact TermLabels.vec_length F B' ht.isUTerm
  · intro i hi
    rw [TermLabels.vec_nth (x∷F) B hn.isUTerm hi,
      nth_termSubstVec ht.termShiftVec.isUTerm hi,nth_termShiftVec ht.isUTerm hi,
      TermLabels.vec_nth F B' ht.isUTerm hi]
    exact term_labels_open (ht.nth hi) F B B' x hB

lemma openAt_isSemiformula {d p : V} (hp : IsSemiformula ℒₛₑₜ (d+1) p) :
    IsSemiformula ℒₛₑₜ d (openAt d p) := hp.shift.subst (openingVec_typed d)

lemma openAt_rel (d : V) {arity R terms : V}
    (hr : (ℒₛₑₜ).IsRel arity R) (ht : IsUTermVec ℒₛₑₜ arity terms) :
    openAt d (^rel arity R terms)=
      ^rel arity R (termSubstVec ℒₛₑₜ arity (openingVec d) (termShiftVec ℒₛₑₜ arity terms)) := by
  rw [openAt,shift_rel hr ht,substs_rel hr ht.termShiftVec]
lemma openAt_nrel (d : V) {arity R terms : V}
    (hr : (ℒₛₑₜ).IsRel arity R) (ht : IsUTermVec ℒₛₑₜ arity terms) :
    openAt d (^nrel arity R terms)=
      ^nrel arity R (termSubstVec ℒₛₑₜ arity (openingVec d) (termShiftVec ℒₛₑₜ arity terms)) := by
  rw [openAt,shift_nrel hr ht,substs_nrel hr ht.termShiftVec]
@[simp] lemma openAt_verum (d : V) : openAt d (^⊤ : V)=^⊤ := by simp [openAt]
@[simp] lemma openAt_falsum (d : V) : openAt d (^⊥ : V)=^⊥ := by simp [openAt]
lemma openAt_and (d : V) {p q : V} (hp : IsUFormula ℒₛₑₜ p) (hq : IsUFormula ℒₛₑₜ q) :
    openAt d (p ^⋏ q)=openAt d p ^⋏ openAt d q := by
  rw [openAt,shift_and hp hq,substs_and hp.shift hq.shift];rfl
lemma openAt_or (d : V) {p q : V} (hp : IsUFormula ℒₛₑₜ p) (hq : IsUFormula ℒₛₑₜ q) :
    openAt d (p ^⋎ q)=openAt d p ^⋎ openAt d q := by
  rw [openAt,shift_or hp hq,substs_or hp.shift hq.shift];rfl
lemma openAt_all (d : V) {p : V} (hp : IsUFormula ℒₛₑₜ p) :
    openAt d (^∀ p)=^∀ (openAt (d+1) p) := by
  rw [openAt,shift_all hp,substs_all hp.shift,←openingVec_succ];rfl
lemma openAt_exs (d : V) {p : V} (hp : IsUFormula ℒₛₑₜ p) :
    openAt d (^∃ p)=^∃ (openAt (d+1) p) := by
  rw [openAt,shift_exs hp,substs_ex hp.shift,←openingVec_succ];rfl

private instance qVecIter_delta : 𝚫₁-Function₂[V] (qVecIter ℒₛₑₜ) :=
  qVecIter_defined.graph_delta.to_definable
private instance subst_delta : 𝚫₁-Function₂[V] (subst ℒₛₑₜ) :=
  subst.defined.graph_delta.to_definable
private instance shift_delta : 𝚫₁-Function₁[V] (shift ℒₛₑₜ) :=
  shift.defined.graph_delta.to_definable
private instance len_delta : 𝚫₁-Function₁[V] (len : V→V) :=
  len_defined.graph_delta.to_definable

lemma encode_openAt {d p : V} (hp : IsSemiformula ℒₛₑₜ (d+1) p)
    (F B B' x fresh : V) (hB : Ext d B B' x) :
    encode (x∷F) B fresh (openAt d p)=encode F B' fresh p := by
  have main : ∀ n p : V, IsSemiformula ℒₛₑₜ n p →
      ∀ d : V, n=d+1 → ∀ F B B' x fresh : V, Ext d B B' x →
        encode (x∷F) B fresh (openAt d p)=encode F B' fresh p := by
    intro n p hp
    apply IsSemiformula.pi1_structural_induction (P := fun n p =>
      ∀ d : V, n=d+1 → ∀ F B B' x fresh : V, Ext d B B' x →
        encode (x∷F) B fresh (openAt d p)=encode F B' fresh p)
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hp
    · unfold Ext openAt openingVec; definability
    · intro n arity R terms hr ht d hn F B B' x s hB
      subst n
      have hv := (openingVec_typed d).termSubstVec ht.termShiftVec
      rw [openAt_rel d hr ht.isUTerm,encode_rel (x∷F) B s hr hv.isUTerm,
        encode_rel F B' s hr ht.isUTerm]
      simp only [ValidatorEnvironmentLabels254.Formulas.atom,nth_adjoin_zero,nth_adjoin_one,
        vec_labels_open ht F B B' x hB]
    · intro n arity R terms hr ht d hn F B B' x s hB
      subst n
      have hv := (openingVec_typed d).termSubstVec ht.termShiftVec
      rw [openAt_nrel d hr ht.isUTerm,encode_nrel (x∷F) B s hr hv.isUTerm,
        encode_nrel F B' s hr ht.isUTerm]
      simp only [ValidatorEnvironmentLabels254.Formulas.atom,nth_adjoin_zero,nth_adjoin_one,
        vec_labels_open ht F B B' x hB]
    · intro n d hn F B B' x s hB; simp
    · intro n d hn F B B' x s hB; simp
    · intro n p q hp hq ihp ihq d hn F B B' x s hB
      subst n
      rw [openAt_and d hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula,
        encode_and (x∷F) B s (openAt_isSemiformula hp).isUFormula
          (openAt_isSemiformula hq).isUFormula,
        encode_and F B' s hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula,
        ihp d rfl F B B' x s hB,ihq d rfl F B B' x s hB]
    · intro n p q hp hq ihp ihq d hn F B B' x s hB
      subst n
      rw [openAt_or d hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula,
        encode_or (x∷F) B s (openAt_isSemiformula hp).isUFormula
          (openAt_isSemiformula hq).isUFormula,
        encode_or F B' s hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula,
        ihp d rfl F B B' x s hB,ihq d rfl F B B' x s hB]
    · intro n p hp ih d hn F B B' x s hB
      subst n
      rw [openAt_all d hp.isUFormula,
        encode_all (x∷F) B s (openAt_isSemiformula hp).isUFormula,
        encode_all F B' s hp.isUFormula]
      exact congrArg (fun body => _root_.SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticCode254.wal s body)
        (ih (d+1) rfl F (s∷B) (s∷B') x (s+2) (ext_cons hB s))
    · intro n p hp ih d hn F B B' x s hB
      subst n
      rw [openAt_exs d hp.isUFormula,
        encode_exs (x∷F) B s (openAt_isSemiformula hp).isUFormula,
        encode_exs F B' s hp.isUFormula,
        ih (d+1) rfl F (s∷B) (s∷B') x (s+2) (ext_cons hB s)]
  exact main (d+1) p hp d rfl F B B' x fresh hB

/-- The matrix identity used by the actual Foundation ALL rule. Source and
target contexts still require the separate formula-level alpha theorem. -/
lemma encode_free {p : V} (hp : IsSemiformula ℒₛₑₜ 1 p) (F x fresh : V) :
    encode (x∷F) 0 fresh (free ℒₛₑₜ p)=encode F (x∷0) fresh p := by
  simpa [openAt,openingVec,free] using
    encode_openAt (d := 0) hp F 0 (x∷0) x fresh (ext_zero x)

end LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ValidatorEnvironmentOpening254

# Opening successor: source-only review

Status: **PREPARED_NOT_BUILT**. This packet has no new Lean kernel result.
No compiler/version query, dependency build, or download was executed by this
agent. Root retains the compiler lease.

The 200-line successor imports only the checked configurable environment
encoder and the checked all-internal specialization module. It proves a proposed
syntax identity, under the explicit finite-vector extension relation

```
Ext(d,B,B',x) := len(B)=d ∧ len(B')=d+1 ∧
                 (∀ i<d, B'[i]=B[i]) ∧ B'[d]=x.
```

For every internal source term/vector/formula of depth d+1, substitution of
`qVecIter d [&0]` into its SHIFTed syntax moves exactly the final bound slot into
the head of the free-label environment. The formula target is

```
E(x::F,B,s, subst(qVecIter d [&0], shift(p))) = E(F,B',s,p).
```

All dimensions, labels, environments, terms and formulas are elements of the
ambient IΣ1 model. There is no external natural-number recursion. The function
symbol case is impossible for the actual internally recognized set language,
using its fixed false function-symbol recognizer. The formula proof uses the
actual `IsSemiformula.pi1_structural_induction` API. Its predicate universally
quantifies the internal dimensions and environments and compares total Delta1
computations, conditional on the bounded extension relation. Required private
Delta1 instances for qVecIter, subst, shift and len are supplied. The quantifier
case pushes the same label onto both bound stacks; `ext_cons` preserves the
extension relation, and `qVecIter_succ` supplies the required substitution vector.

At depth zero, `encode_free` gives the actual Foundation free(p) matrix identity.
The two finite clients `encode_all_opened` and `encode_exs_opened` show precisely
how the current bound label appears at the free-environment head. They are
computational equalities. The source permits x=0 and arbitrary next label s;
therefore it proves no reserved-label, freshness, alpha-equivalence, CProv proof
transport, axiom transport, or source-proof-compiler assertion. Context alpha
conversion remains open.

Reviewed actual providers and APIs:

- Maintained `ValidatorEnvironmentLabels254.lean` in full, especially total
  labels, term/vector construction equations and all formula constructor rules.
- Maintained `ModelCodedSpecialization.lean` through the qVec iterator and
  `qVecIter_free_spec`; the small checked evidence for this module is used.
- Foundation `Bootstrapping/Syntax/Term/Basic.lean` typed term case split;
  `Term/Functions.lean` termShift, substitution and vector-nth equations.
- Foundation `Bootstrapping/Syntax/Formula/Basic.lean` actual typed Π1 induction;
  `Formula/Functions.lean` constructor substitution and actual free definition.
- Maintained `Instances.lean` and Foundation internal-language symbol recognizers.

The saved 184-line draft is retained unchanged as `original-saved-draft.lean`.
Before any proof run, the focused successor replaces the index-bound conversion
with the known `lt_succ_iff_le.mp` API, explicitly unfolds `substs1` in the depth-zero
corollary, and adds the two finite opened-matrix clients. The exact diff is
`saved-to-focused-source.diff`. No hypothesis was strengthened to hide a gap.

The 86-line audit contains 19 named axiom probes and 22 callers. It covers every
public proposition, all-internal dimensions, the raw zero-label case, a nested
universal body, and the direct distinguished-variable computation. These are
pending callers, not successful test results.

The runner is adapted from the checked environment runner; the complete delta
is `environment-to-opening-guard.diff`. It pins the exact source/audit, both
parent PASS records, their fresh objects, all current selected source/object
pairs, the compiler binary/version record and dependency pins. The exact actual
closure has 23 project modules and six external boundaries. Shared modules have
identical source/object hashes. The actual Cantor object remains the environment
lane's `fc2255ba949115e1a8bf070b76e5dfb4b7b27f7ab8b8145de7707d07c8a71972`.

Two cached direct boundaries are newly required relative to the environment
lane: `Foundation.FirstOrder.Bootstrapping.Syntax.Proof.Typed` and
`Foundation.FirstOrder.Incompleteness.InductionSchemeDelta1`. They are inherited
from the checked specialization closure; their current source/object hashes and
actual first namespace providers match. They are not newly compiled here and no
entire Foundation namespace attestation is asserted. The machine-readable
inventory records every path and full hash.

The preparatory run checks 70 paths before/after, actual first providers,
dependency state and the 19/22 audit contract. It has `commands=[]` and
`compiler_version_query_performed=false`. The future compiler run uses one
thread, 4 GiB, default limits and a 120-second timeout per source/audit command.
It persists the fresh object hash immediately after source PASS and before audit.
